title: Damage Compliance Holdback and Violation Points (FBN)
content:
Active violation points and the standing status on a seller's Seller Performance Standing record decide the damage compliance holdback on a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) warehouse-damage approval: it is waived (0 units) for a seller with no active violation points whose standing status is good standing, and is the high damage compliance holdback of 3 units for a seller with at least the damage violation-point trigger of 6 active violation points. For every other seller the damage compliance holdback is not altered by this provision.

## Cases (hypothetical sellers)

| Seller | Active violation points | Standing status | Damage compliance holdback |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | 0 | good standing | 0 units |
| B | 0 | at risk | not altered |
| C | 2 | good standing | not altered |
| D | 6 | at risk | 3 units |
| E | 11 | good standing | 3 units |

Seller B shows that the waiver needs the good standing status as well as zero points; seller E shows that 6 or more active points give the high holdback whatever the status.
